newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures end firmer on Tokyo rebound.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures end firmer on Tokyo rebound.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei stock index futures sustained gains on Wednesday to end firmer riding on the back of Tokyo's stock market recovery, dealers said.
Japanese institutional bargain-hunting, resulting from the previous day's sell-off, lent Nikkei futures early support.
"It was pretty decent interest for Christmas Day," one foreign commission house dealer said, but added the turnover of 8,743 lots was mostly inspired by short covering.
The key March Nikkei contract closed at 19,545, up 305 points from Tuesday, recapturing roughly most of its losses but with the market considered still fundamentally weak.
Prices are expected to trade narrowly through next week, with Japanese companies on holiday and other financial centres closing books ahead of the new year.
Dealers said SIMEX Nikkei futures would likely move sideways until major participants resume business in the new year and Japan economic data set a new direction.
"Going from what we have now, the market is vulnerable to an 18,500 downside," one local dealer said.
